content:
Building on last week's announcement (#announce > Sphere Packing Milestone), we are thrilled to announce yet another achievement: Math Inc has managed to use Gauss to come up with a sorry-free proof of the sphere packing problem in dimension 242424 as well!

The dimension 242424 solution is on a branch of Math Inc's fork of our repository. We have already conducted a preliminary review, and once we finish merging the 888-dimensional formalisation (spherepacking#341), we will begin a more detailed review of the 242424-dimensional case.

To reiterate the sentiment expressed in our dimension 888 announcement, we are immensely grateful to all our contributors, supporters and well-wishers as we announce this extraordinary accomplishment. We look forward to continuing our collaboration with Math Inc and the broader community to merge the Gauss code into our codebase.

Discussion thread: #Sphere packing in 8 dimensions > Discussion for Autoformalization

Following up on last week's announcement regarding the completion of the optimality of sphere packing in 8 dimensions, we are incredibly excited to announce that Gauss has now completed the formalization of Viazovska's sphere packing optimality and uniqueness results for dimension 24.

Building on the core definitions and formal foundations established during the dimension 8 effort, Gauss operated directly from the official published paper for this result. It dynamically executed autonomous literature searches over the course of the formalization run to bridge gaps and complete the proof.

In total, Gauss originally generated about 500K lines of Lean to complete the proof, which was subsequently compressed down to 180K lines in the released version.
